root_cause_analysis: Meta API application request limit reached and action blocked (OAuthException code 4, subcode 2207051). Meta has flagged or temporarily restricted automated publishing activity on the account.
actionable_instructions: Log into the Instagram app or Meta Business Suite for 'Market Debunk Tamil' to verify if a manual security challenge or policy violation warning needs acknowledgement.
Pause automated publishing scripts for at least 24 hours to allow the Meta action block/rate limit window to expire.
Check Meta Developer Portal application dashboard for API rate limit usage graphs and appeal any false-positive spam blocks if prompted.
